title: Free road
description:
Isometric puzzle game

                           InfoThis is a puzzle game, where you need to pave the way for a car. 
To put the road, you must select the desired one and drag it to the empty block. To remove the road, you need to tap on it. At the moment, the game has 45 levels. More levels coming soon!Features• 45 Levels

• Isometric graphics
